collapses_to.tool: a single idempotency-keyed ingest that takes a set of governance records and their control mappings, so a re-push updates the record it already created instead of the piece probing for a marker it wrote itself

idempotency.verified_at: The createEvidence tool description published by https://api.noru.tech/v1/mcp documents creating text/note/link evidence with optional control mappings and states that file uploads are not supported over MCP; it documents no idempotency key. The "Idempotency/Upsert Behavior" section of https://api.noru.tech/llms.txt covers assets and security findings only. No key is documented for evidence, so this piece does not assume one.
idempotency.gap: No idempotency key is documented for evidence, so this piece does not rely on one: it embeds a marker built from the record key and a digest of the rendered account in the evidence description, and probes getOrganizationEvidence before creating. A documented key for evidence — an externalId, or the record key plus a content hash — would let the probe go away and would turn a rewritten account into an update rather than a second record.

idempotency.verified_at: The linkEvidenceToControl tool description published by https://api.noru.tech/v1/mcp documents linking an evidence record to a control and optionally narrowing the link to specific evidence-item template ids. It documents nothing about what a repeated link does, so this piece treats a repeat as unspecified rather than as safe.
idempotency.gap: The published description does not say whether linking the same evidence to the same control twice is a no-op, so the piece never relies on that: it reads the evidence record's current control links from getOrganizationEvidence and only emits a link that is genuinely missing. Documented repeat-link behaviour would let the probe go away.

source.note: The organization's controls and their status. Ids come from Noru; this plugin ships none.

The full context for one control: what the framework expects of it, what is already linked, its coverage, and the procedure an auditor follows. The difference between expected and linked IS the queue.
The catalogue of framework-level evidence-item templates, used to resolve titles and types for items the control context returns by id.
Cross-check of what is already attached to a control before proposing another record.
